name: 6-(2-aminopropyl)tetralin
summary: 6-(2-Aminopropyl)tetralin (6-APT), also sometimes called tetralinylaminopropane (TAP), is a drug of the amphetamine class which acts as a selective serotonin releasing agent (SSRA). It has IC50 values of 121 nM, 6,436 nM, and 3,371 nM for inhibiting the reuptake of serotonin, dopamine, and norepinephrine, respectively.

pharmacology.text: 6-(2-Aminopropyl)tetralin (6-APT), also sometimes called tetralinylaminopropane (TAP), is a drug of the amphetamine class which acts as a selective serotonin releasing agent (SSRA). It has IC50 values of 121 nM, 6,436 nM, and 3,371 nM for inhibiting the reuptake of serotonin, dopamine, and norepinephrine, respectively.

uses.en: It is a research compound used in laboratory studies of serotonin release. It is not a medicine.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，用於血清素釋放的實驗室研究，並不是藥品。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，用于血清素释放的实验室研究，并不是药品。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs that release serotonin strongly, such as MDMA, can cause jaw clenching, sweating, overheating, nausea, a racing heart and a low mood in the days after. Serious risks include dangerous overheating, low blood sodium from drinking too much water, and serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。強烈釋放血清素的藥物（例如MDMA）可能引起咬緊牙關、出汗、體溫過高、噁心、心跳急促，以及之後幾天的情緒低落。嚴重風險包括危險的體溫過高、因喝太多水造成的低血鈉，以及血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。强烈释放血清素的药物（例如MDMA）可能引起咬紧牙关、出汗、体温过高、恶心、心跳急促，以及之后几天的情绪低落。严重风险包括危险的体温过高、因喝太多水造成的低血钠，以及血清素症候群。

fact.en: Its tetralin ring is a benzene ring fused to a six-carbon ring. Locking the molecule into this rigid shape makes it release serotonin almost exclusively, leaving dopamine largely alone.
fact.zh: 它的四氫萘環是苯環與一個六碳環相連而成。把分子鎖成這種僵硬的形狀，使它幾乎只釋放血清素，而幾乎不影響多巴胺。
fact.zhHans: 它的四氢萘环是苯环与一个六碳环相连而成。把分子锁成这种僵硬的形状，使它几乎只释放血清素，而几乎不影响多巴胺。
